Checked: worker gate (build=0, depcheck=0, outside-folder=0), depcheck rerun (0 problems), elaboration (28 sorry warnings only), one-tactic probes on every sorry, the 15 sampled targets against Marker 2013 notes, Keisler-Knight preprint and Erdos-Rado 1956, the Layer 6 graph-translation declarations and Mathlib cardinal names at the pins, cross-roadmap citations on main, and a 35-row adversarial table with no mathematical defect.
